pages.text: [#](53341a)Eleven chapters lie ahead of this one, pupil, and they open in their proper order — craft a subject's book and its pages appear here. Here is the whole road, so you may see where your feet are headed:[#]()
pages.title: Path of the Craft

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Getting Started** — the altar, the boline, the first roots. **1. Collecting Fumes** — the Witches' Oven and the breaths and odours it renders. **2. Herbology** — Mutandis, the Rowan, the Witch's Cauldron.[#]()

[#](53341a)**3. Brews & Infusions** — the Kettle, and the four paths of infusion. **4. Distilling** — drawing essences out by heat and patience. **5. Circle Magic** — chalk, circles, and the rites of power.[#]()

[#](53341a)**6. Conjuration** — the Brazier, fetishes, and the things you call. **7. Symbology** — the Mystic Branch and glyphs traced in the air. **8. Poppets** — taglocks, poppets, and binding from afar.[#]()

[#](53341a)**9. The Spirit World** — dreams, the dead, and the far country. **10. Creatures** — familiars and the beasts of the craft. **11. Transformations** — the deeper changes: the wolf, the night.[#]()

[#](53341a)The order is a teacher's order, not a cage.[#]()
[#](53341a)Should a coven witch or a dusty bookshop press a later chapter into your hands early, read it gladly — knowledge found is knowledge still.[#]()
